quote: On May 21, 2026, Google DeepMind published an arXiv paper announcing that its AlphaProof Nexus agent had autonomously solved nine open Erdős mathematical problems.
kind_note: AI mathematical agent harness combining LLM with Lean proof assistant
note: AlphaProof Nexus is an agentic orchestration system, not a standalone model. It pairs a large language model with Lean formal verification. The system was announced via arXiv preprint (2605.22763v1) on May 21, 2026.
